svg.title: Net jobs gained against the control for every screened idea, by idea family
svg.desc: Of the 19 comparisons that passed on half A and were then run on half B against the same control in a later run, 18 failed there, and 29 of the 164 comparisons on the two halves passed their rule.

g.text: 18 of the 19 comparisons that passed on half A failed when run on half B against the same control in a later run.
A line joins each such pass to its half-B run. 29 of the 164 comparisons drawn passed their rule.

text.tspan: on half A, −1 on half B
